Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <3558A742...@innocent.com>, Regret
<reg...@innocent.com> writes
>If I use the island to increase a Pricus's hand damage.
>how much is it increased by?

By zero. Except during the Prisci sub-vote, a Prisci has no votes.
This counts for any effect based on the number of votes a vampire has
(that Lasombra one that allows you to kill them and get their votes, for
instance, gets 0 from a Lasombra).

>And does the number of Pricus on the table affect it?

No. It's always zero.

--

5) The Priscus title provides 0 votes in the larger sense, even though it
provides 1 vote for purposes of the Prisci subvote. Thus, for example,
using Island of Yiaros on a Priscus gives that vampire +0 hand damage.
